tools.name: search_places
tools.description: Find places in Metro Manila by city, category, name fragment, or near a coordinate. Call list_categories before filtering on a category. Coverage stops at Metro Manila (OSM relation 147488): no Cebu, Davao, Baguio or Dumaguete.

tools.name: get_place
tools.description: Return one place record by the id returned from search_places.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: The normalised category vocabulary with counts. Call this before filtering on a category - the vocabulary is the site's, not yours.

tools.name: list_cities
tools.description: Returns an empty list: these place records carry no city field. Narrow by `near` coordinates or by category instead.

tools.name: site_stats
tools.description: Record count, discovered table and build time. Call this before reporting that something does not exist.
